title: Final Probability Function
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for p(x) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Energy Conservation Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly state and use the energy conservation equation for the harmonic oscillator.

title: Period Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the period T must be correctly derived from the integral involving the potential energy.

title: Correct Probability Density Form
description: Important Criteria: The form of the probability density function must be consistent with the derived expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the energy equation.

title: Integration Limits
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that the integration limits for the period calculation are correctly set from -l to l.
